Caroline Guitar Company browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal events 2015 NAMM 2015 Caroline Guitar Company Wave Cannon MkII Superdistorter Published on January 3, 2015 Caroline Guitar Company distortion overdrive pedal NAMM 2015 1985 edition (Black Friday 2017) 1985 edition preview preview WC2 WC2 WC2 WC2 Information Caroline Guitar Company So, what IS the story on Wave Cannon® version 2.0, or as we've decided to call it, the Wave Cannon MKII Superdistorter?  The long story short is that this thing is an unrepentant, unapologetic distortion pedal that is totally nasty and fun. This Cannon comes pre-loaded with balls (pun alert!) and is capable of going from cranked, lightly dirty amp tones to the sound of a furry Godzilla devouring a junkyard full of broken a/c window units. It's different than the original, which was based on the classic '70s fuzzstortions we grew up playing. It's different from our Haymaker, which is a wide range drive pedal based around the rotation of a clipping network into different locations in the circuit, and which is intended to respond and feel like an extension of your amp. This pedal is really about rocking your socks off. While it can do some extremely cool mild-to-medium crunch tones, Wave Cannon II is really capable of overwhelming your amp.
